state.title: State without the boilerplate
state.description: NgRx SignalStore replaces actions, reducers and effects with a single declarative store. No services holding private signals, no subscriptions to clean up.
points: Stores provided in root and injected straight into components
Computed values derive automatically, with no manual wiring
patchState keeps updates type-safe end to end

auth.title: Tokens your JavaScript can't read
auth.description: Most templates store the JWT in localStorage, which means any injected script can walk off with the session. Here the token never reaches JavaScript.

storage.localStorage: In the browser store, readable by any script
storage.httpOnly: In a cookie the browser refuses to expose to JavaScript

xss.localStorage: The session is stolen in a single line
xss.httpOnly: The script cannot read the cookie

csrf.localStorage: Not needed, but the token is exposed

refresh.httpOnly: The cookie travels on its own, session validated on init

setup.localStorage: Return the token in the response body

proven.title: Bugs this template no longer has
proven.description: Every one of these was real, and shipped. They are here because a template that only lists features tells you nothing about the mistakes it already made for you.

csrf.symptom: Every login went out without its CSRF header, so a backend that validated CSRF would reject the first mutation of each session.
csrf.cause: Startup asked for the token and the session at once, and the ordinary 401 of an anonymous visitor reset the state — wiping the token that had just arrived.

startup.symptom: The advertised "session validation on startup" had never run once.
startup.cause: The store did HTTP while being constructed, and those requests pass through the interceptor that injects that same store. Angular aborted with a circular dependency and the requests never left the browser.

guards.symptom: Reloading inside a protected route threw out users whose session was perfectly valid.
guards.cause: The guard decided before the session check had resolved. Both guards now wait for it.

router.symptom: The router did nothing. Adding a second route would not have worked.
router.cause: The bootstrap component was registered as a route component, and its template had no router outlet: the landing rendered because it was embedded in the shell.

theme.symptom: The theme was never applied — the site showed daisyUI's defaults.
theme.cause: The stylesheet declared it with v4 variable names on a v5 install, which had renamed them all. Dead code from top to bottom.

proven.note: All of them are written up, with their root cause, in the changelog.
